visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of an indoor stage. A female conductor in a black suit stands in the center with her back to the camera, gesturing with a baton. To her left, a young woman with long black hair and bangs, dressed in a red and black sleeveless costume with pink arm sleeves, holds a silver flute. An orchestra, including violinists and a drummer, is positioned behind them. The background is a large red banner with white text and cartoon characters. (2) The camera transitions to a medium shot of the flutist. She is playing the silver flute with high energy, her body swaying rhythmically to the music. Her facial expressions are animated and focused. The lighting is bright and uniform across the stage, emphasizing the vibrant red of her outfit. (3) The scene shifts back to a wide shot showing the coordination between the conductor, the flutist, and the orchestra. The violinists are seen moving their bows in unison. The flutist continues her performance with sharp, synchronized body movements. (4) In the final phase, the camera captures a close-up of the flutist as she finishes her piece. She stops playing, lifts her left arm high into the air, and shouts with an excited expression. She then strikes a final pose, smiling broadly at the audience as the performance concludes.
